description: Crew 17 and the incoming Crew 18 conducted an in-person, same-day 'hot swap' handover on Devon Island — the outgoing crew briefed the arriving crew on pertinent station maintenance issues before departing on the same aircraft. Described in the report as a first for the Mars Society.
response: The outgoing crew collected water for the incoming crew in advance, cleaned and organized the station, and gave a verbal handover briefing on maintenance issues before the incoming crew's plane departed with them.
lesson: A same-day, in-person hot-swap handover transfers tacit knowledge (maintenance status, known issues) far better than a written report read after the fact — but this handover was verbal only. Pair any future hot-swap with a short written checklist so nothing depends on memory under the time pressure of a same-day changeover (compare FMARS-C18-2025-EVT001, where the wall-heater handover task was itself communicated only verbally and nearly missed).
